question: Who among the following personalities was appointed as the legal advisor of the Constituent Assembly that drafted the document of the Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**BN Rau.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **BN Rau was appointed as the legal advisor of the Constituent Assembly that drafted the document of the Constitution.**
 
• He was a renowned Indian civil servant and jurist.
 
• Rau played a crucial role in the drafting of the Indian Constitution and provided valuable inputs to the Constituent Assembly.
 
• From 1950 to 1952, Rau served as India's delegate to the UN Security Council.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **H.V.R Iyengar** was a prominent lawyer and freedom fighter.

 
 
• **He served as a member of the Constituent Assembly. **
 
 
 
• **S.N. Mukherjee** was a lawyer and politician.
 
 
• **The Principal Constitutional Draftsman in the Constituent Assembly was S. N. Mukherjee.**
 
 
 
• **B.R. Ambedkar** was the chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly.
 
 
• **He was a political activist, social reformer, economist, and jurist from India.**
